svg.text: LEVEL TWO — THE THINGS GET EYES · 188 KERNELS, EACH AN OBSERVER ON THE 13-PROTOFILAMENT WEB
each eye looks along its 8-start Fibonacci pathway at the tubulin it can verify · pupil points at the observed · the web begins to see itself · eyes are observers, not sight
180 eyes see a neighbour · 8 at the pathway's end see only the nought · an eye is a measured observation, not consciousness · SYSTEM_AFFIRMED=0
